name: ide
description: Primary ATA channel at the ports (1F0-1F7, 3F6, IRQ14), PIO: reset signature, IDENTIFY, diagnostic, absent slave, invalid command, IRQ14 latch, LBA and CHS reads, multi-sector and READ MULTIPLE, 256-sector count, verify, seek, set features, past-the-end errors. Read-only: nothing is written to the disk (the cell's disk is write-protected).
